description: A solitary ambush predator of the denser Outer Old-Growth Wild, estate-border forest, and shadowed understory. Mossveils take Feywoodhorn stag, smaller deer, foxes, and briarmane courser young. They are the Feywood's emblem of quiet danger, patience, and unseen movement.

ecology.cultural_role: emblem of quiet danger, patience, unseen movement

name: Mossveil Cat
